Points needing your eye

Three judgement calls in this round

  1. Adjusted colours awaiting your verdict. Tulip Orange #E0813C (from #D49D6A, to read properly orange), Rust Orange #B57E63 and Deep Plum #8E7990 (both lightened a step at your request). Say if any wants pushing further either way.
  2. White button text. Applied everywhere, as you specified. On the palest buttons — Spring's Sky Blue and Rose Pink especially — white is soft against the colour. If any button proves hard to read on the real phone, the remedy is deepening that button's colour a step (same hue), not changing the text. Judge it on your screen and say.
  3. How editing works (your question, answered for the function stage): tap an entry in the This Month list and it highlights, and its contents load into the form above. The Save button becomes Update while editing, so you change what you see and press Update; Delete asks “are you sure?” then removes the highlighted entry. Journal entries appear in the same list and edit the same way, photographs included — each photo carries its small ✕ to remove it, and Add Photos appends more.

Also recorded: the backup banner is gone. Save Backup & Exit always writes a fresh backup file as it closes, so the reminder became unnecessary — the one path it cannot cover is closing the app by swiping it away, where entries are safe in the app's own storage but no new backup file is made.

The output documents

Two revised samples to check on your PC

Rebuilt again to your round-3 corrections, and now keeping one palette whatever the season: Pale Cream page, gold frame and dividers, Mustard Yellow title enlarged above a Seafoam date, Seafoam day headings. The border is recomposed so its centre ornaments keep their true shape at print sharpness instead of stretching, and in the journal the squiggle divider now separates one day from the next rather than underlining each date. Checks: the title larger than the date and both in the diary's lettering; the frame crisp with nothing stretched; a divider between days, not under them; the table clear of the border.

Say what to change and I'll revise again — rounds are cheap at this stage. Stage 2 begins when you approve the four screens, one icon, and both documents.
